% values.tex --- canonical macro layer for Bitter Pills (v6-jpub-short).
%
% Rules:
%   * Every number/estimate/sample-size in the manuscript prose must come
%     from a \BPxxx macro defined here or written by an analysis script.
%   * Defaults below use \providecommand so that \renewcommand from the
%     auto-generated blocks (further below in this file, regenerated by
%     analysis/_macros.R) overrides them when scripts run.
%   * If a macro is still TBD, the manuscript renders it in red so the
%     missing value is visible at a glance.
%   * Auto-generated blocks are delimited by lines:
%       %     Edit those blocks ONLY by re-running the producing script.

\providecommand{\BPtbd}[1]{\textcolor{red}{TBD-#1}}

% --------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Path shortcuts: \BPvtab/\BPvfig route to v4 outputs;
%                 \BPotab/\BPofig route to v6 (output/) outputs.
% Use these in section files instead of writing relative paths inline.
% --------------------------------------------------------------------------
\providecommand{\BPvtab}[1]{\input{../../../v4/pub/tables/#1}}
\providecommand{\BPotab}[1]{\input{../../output/tables/#1}}
\providecommand{\BPvfig}[1]{#1}                 % v4 figs are on \graphicspath
\providecommand{\BPofig}[1]{../../output/figures/#1}

% v8 SOURCING REFRAME SCHEMA --- bounded UTG + within-firm reconciliation +

% --- Reconciliation log-gap components (manual; algebraic of 45_reconciliation auto block) ---
% These are the four bars of the admin-minus-lit identity in Figure 1 / Table tab:utg_reconciliation,
% expressed in log-points and percent. Derived from BPutgQtyGapAdminLit, BPutgBulkElasticity,
% BPutgTripleCoefUTG, and observed naive UTG (-0.259 from tab_utg_boottest).
\providecommand{\BPutgObsLogGap}{\ensuremath{-0.259}}                   % observed admin-minus-lit log-points
\providecommand{\BPutgMechLogGap}{\ensuremath{-0.397}}                  % mechanical C1 = bulkElast x qtyGap
\providecommand{\BPutgWithinLogGap}{\ensuremath{+0.035}}                % within firm-buyer-item triple
\providecommand{\BPutgCompLogGap}{\ensuremath{+0.103}}                  % residual = obs - mech - within
\providecommand{\BPutgMechPctAbs}{32.8\%}                               % admin cheaper from quantity alone
\providecommand{\BPutgCompPctSign}{11\%}                                % admin supplier mix more expensive than lit, conditional on Q
\providecommand{\BPutgObsPctLitOverAdmin}{23\%}                         % 1 - exp(-0.259), level-terms lit-over-admin
